description: Source code for user-related API endpoints in a Mattermost Focalboard server, including user retrieval, user list, user preferences, and user configuration management.

methods.name: registerUsersRoutes
methods.description: Registers user-related API routes to the router

methods.name: handleGetUsersList
methods.description: Handles retrieval of a list of users based on provided IDs

methods.name: handleGetMe
methods.description: Retrieves the currently logged-in user's information

methods.name: handleGetMyMemberships
methods.description: Retrieves the board memberships of the current user

methods.name: handleGetUser
methods.description: Retrieves a specific user's information by userID

methods.name: handleUpdateUserConfig
methods.description: Updates the configuration/preferences of a user

methods.name: handleGetUserPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves preferences of the current user
